text:
kai: Heads up, PR #4910 with the SDK snippets and migration checklist is failing docs CI due to a Vale rule and a few broken internal anchors.
ci-bot: docs preview failed for PR #4910 on branch `docs/sdk-snippets-checklist`
- link-check: 2 broken internal anchors in `migration-checklist.md`
- vale: 1 error (Consistency.ItemCasing) in `sdk-snippets.md`
- mdlint: no errors
marin: Can you paste the anchor errors? Might be the checklist headers were moved to subheaders.
kai: From the CI output:```
WARN: broken anchor in migration-checklist.md: target `#update-deps` not found
WARN: broken anchor in migration-checklist.md: target `#adjust-configs` not found
```
devex: Those headers became `### Update dependencies` and `### Adjust configuration` in a previous refactor, which slugify to `#update-dependencies` and `#adjust-configuration`. Links need to be updated to match.
marin: For Vale Consistency.ItemCasing, what did it flag exactly?
ci-bot: Vale snippet in `sdk-snippets.md`:```
## Using the Java sdk
The examples below show how to call the API.
```
Rule suggests `Java SDK` instead of `Java sdk` and `API` is ok.
kai: Quick fixes: change link targets to `#update-dependencies` and `#adjust-configuration`, update header casing to `Java SDK`. I'll bundle into one commit and run `make docs-lint` locally.
sam: Also run `tools/slugify.py migration-checklist.md` to confirm slugs.
kai: Running lint locally now. Saw Vale warning cleared after renaming header; local link-check also passed after updates. Pushing in ~8 mins.
marin: I'll do a quick review once pushed.
[8 minutes later]
kai: Pushed commit `c8b5d2e` -> branch `docs/sdk-snippets-checklist`. PR auto-updated.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4910. Running preview...
Status: link-check: OK, vale: OK, md-lint: OK
Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4910
marin: LGTM. One tiny nit: in `sdk-snippets.md` header `## Using the Java SDK` maybe add code block language hints in the examples. Not necessary for merge.
sam: Approving for merge.
marin: Approved.
ci-bot: PR #4910 approved by sam, marin. Added to merge batch.
ci-bot: Merged at 11:12 PT ":"commit`c8b5d2e`" SDK snippet casing and migration checklist anchor fixes.
